[[File:Marius AG036.png|thumb|250px|Marius]] '''Marius''' (Japanese: '''ヨウスケ''' ''Yōsuke'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG036|The Spheal of Approval]]''. He is the self-appointed security guard of {{ci|Slateport}}'s [[Oceanic Museum]]. Marius spotted [[Max]] as he was trying to climb the wall of the closed museum. As a result, he assumed that {{Ash}} and Max were trying to break in because they were thieves. At this, Marius sent out his {{p|Spheal}} to attack them, not listening to their repeated denials. However, Spheal wasn't interested in battling and only wanted to play. {{AP|Pikachu}} quickly defeated Spheal with a single {{m|Thunderbolt}}, leaving Marius speechless. Max explained {{type|Water}}s are weak against {{type|Electric}} [[move]]s. Soon, [[Captain Stern]] arrived, and Marius promptly told him Ash and Max were thieves. Max explained that he just wanted to see the museum. After dealing with the misunderstanding, Captain Stern invited them all in to see the museum. Marius displayed his lack of knowledge about Pokémon during the tour, where he declared that he wanted to catch a {{p|Goldeen}} so it could evolve into a {{p|Gyarados}}. Max corrected him, saying only {{p|Magikarp}} evolve into Gyarados. Marius also dreamed about traveling around the world by sea inside the submarine that the Captain was building. Marius, Ash, and Max were later captured by {{TRT}} after being lured out by snow cones. They soon escaped with the help of [[Ash's Corphish]] and confronted [[Team Magma]], who had stolen Stern's valuable rock. Captain Stern and Ash handled Team Magma while Marius and Max were ordered to get [[Officer Jenny]]. Marius and Max jumped off a steep sea cliff, while his Spheal aided the pair in reaching the police. By the time the police arrived, Team Magma fled with a portion of the stone. Afterwards, Marius informed Ash of his desire to have a [[rematch]] the next time they met. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Marius |pkmn=Spheal |type1=Ice |type2=Water |img=Marius Spheal.png |epnum=AG036 |epname=The Spheal of Approval |vajp=Chie Satō |vaen=Kayzie Rogers |desc={{p|Spheal}} is Marius's only known Pokémon. He sent it out to deal with {{Ash}} and [[Max]] when he assumed that they were thieves. Ash used his {{AP|Pikachu}} to battle Spheal. However, Spheal spent much of its time clapping rather than battling and was defeated easily by a single {{m|Thunderbolt}}. Later, Spheal repeated this behavior while Marius, Ash, and Max were stuck in {{TRT}}'s cage. Spheal was shown to be adept at traversing large bodies of water at very high speeds when it swam Max and Marius to the shore opposite the [[Oceanic Museum]]. Spheal's known moves are {{m|Body Slam}}, {{m|Water Gun}}, and {{m|Blizzard}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{ice color}}|bordercolor={{water color light}} |it=Patrizia Mottola |ja=くまいもとこ ''[[Motoko Kumai]]'' |ar=أسمهان بيطار ''Asmahan Bitar'' |en=[[Tara Jayne]] |pt_br=Francisco Freitas |es_la=Claudio Velázquez |es_eu=Sara Vivas}} ==Trivia== * Marius bears a striking resemblance to the {{tc|Bug Catcher}} {{DL|Pokémon Trainer|Trainer class}} in the {{pkmn|games}}. Despite this, he does not own any {{type|Bug}} Pokémon. * Marius shares his name with another [[character of the day]], [[Captain Marius]]. Similarly, this Marius makes the impression that he is striving to become a sea captain.
